text_block_list.text:
Grass Wonder finished the race. But 
despite receiving immense praise, she 
couldn't shake off her reputation as mere 
"Maruzensky's successor."

To completely transform how people viewed 
her, Grass Wonder set her sights on a 
direct showdown with Maruzensky.

Aiming to make that a reality, and to gain 
more experience running in Classic 
races... she first decided to enter the 
Japanese Derby.
